# Final results on the 50 real photos (generated by `src/final_report.py`)

Model: `e14_consistent`. No ground truth exists for these photos: this lists evidence, not verified answers.
Thresholds: cut-off > 1 % of the ink outside the photo; difference map > 1 %; letter shift > 0.17 half-size px (95th percentile of genuine synthetic); colour = EXP-005 hue flag; model = its own validation thresholds.
